en: The postcard features a black-and-white (with hand coloring indicated) scenic view from a shaded structure, looking out over a park with trees, foliage, and distant mountains. In the background, structures or buildings can be seen partially obscured by the lush greenery. There is text in red ink on the bottom and sides, as well as a printed number in red in the lower right corner.
